controllerType: Xinghuo 全自动缝纫控制系统 (Fully Automatic Sewing Control System) 二代人机界面 (Gen-II HMI) V1.4
type: Automatic template sewing machine with CNC controller
source: Electric control manual MS100A_v1.4.pdf (深圳市星火数控技术有限公司, 2019年10月 V1.4, Chinese only)
note: The MS100A machine uses the Xinghuo (星火) Fully Automatic Sewing Control System Gen-II HMI (二代人机界面). This is the V1.4 (2019) version of the same Xinghuo controller platform documented in XH-AutoSewing.json. The controller features a 7-inch color touchscreen, XY servo axes, and supports .SLW format pattern files. For full parameter and error code details, refer to XH-AutoSewing.json. Key differences noted in this V1.4 manual: supports Vietnamese, Japanese, Korean and Chinese/English display (not the same language list as the newer version).

specs.groundingRequirement: resistance < 100 ohm, wire length < 20m, cross-section > 1.0 sq mm

panel.type: 7-inch color LCD touchscreen with physical buttons (PAUSE, OPEN/顶板, PRESS/压框, START/启动)
mainScreenElements: Current processing file name and dimensions
Main shaft speed display and increase/decrease
Total stitch count and current stitch count
Quick rewind/advance (线段快退/快进) buttons
Press frame (压框) and press foot (压脚) buttons

mainMenuItems.name: 文件管理 (File Management)
mainMenuItems.function: Import/export/delete files to/from internal memory and USB

mainMenuItems.name: 文件编辑 (File Edit)
mainMenuItems.function: Create new or edit existing sewing patterns (capture mode: point, line, rectangle, arc, circle, curve, multi-segment)

mainMenuItems.name: 用户参数 (User Parameters)
mainMenuItems.function: Adjust common user parameters for processing requirements

mainMenuItems.name: 辅助设置 (Auxiliary Settings)
mainMenuItems.function: Processing auxiliary setup and testing (I/O test, winding, manual jog, baseline calibration)

mainMenuItems.name: 网络文件 (Network Files)
mainMenuItems.function: Download shared processing files from server

mainMenuItems.name: 机器状态 (Machine Status)
mainMenuItems.function: Remote management and reporting machine status for troubleshooting

operations.fileLock: Tap 锁文件 icon to lock current file and prevent accidental file changes. Auto-template recognition only works when file is locked.
operations.templateRecognition: Two modes: by file name (RFID/IC card reader) or by file number (barcode scanner). Set in user parameters → other settings → template recognition method.
operations.datum: Tap 基准 to enter baseline point setup. Align sewing path to physical template position. Supports dual datum points.
operations.trialSew: Tap 试缝 (trial sew) to trace XY pattern path without main shaft rotating — for verifying needle position.
operations.winding: Enter test interface, set winding speed (default 1500 rpm), tap 允许, then START to begin winding. Tap STOP or 返回 to stop.

figureEdit.scale: Scale figure width and height by percentage
figureEdit.extend: Add or remove stitches at start/end of each segment
figureEdit.setStitchLength: Modify stitch pitch length for entire figure

fileManagement.internalStorage: Up to 999 files, max 128MB total. File names: up to 15 Chinese chars or 30 ASCII chars. Format: .SLW only.
fileManagement.usbStorage: Insert USB to access USB file management. Copy/import .SLW and .xhp files. Parameter files shown when entering via parameter file management.

note2: For complete parameter tables (User Parameters Chapters 6, Machine Parameters Chapter 7) and error/alarm codes (Appendix 1), see XH-AutoSewing.json which documents the same Xinghuo controller platform.
